text_block_list.text:
At last, the autumn Tenno Sho is upon
us. Biwa
Hayahide watches from the
stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Нарита Брайан exchanges
a few
words with Огури Кэп, who says
she can't lose
because she's racing for
the people back in her
hometown,
Kasamatsu.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Both make their way to the track,
preparing to
give the race everything
they have.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
